response.justification: The candidate brings genuine geospatial domain experience (founding GISCollective, building GIS applications for Green Map) and proven low-latency systems work handling millions of requests per second with asynchronous I/O in DLang. However, his professional C++ experience is limited and dated (2014–2015 at National Instruments), he has no Rust experience, and his recent roles center on TypeScript/Node.js product work rather than systems programming. He lacks direct routing/navigation pipeline experience, though his systems performance background and demonstrated adaptability across stacks make him worth a conversation if the C++ requirement can be flexed for a strong systems generalist.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial data experience via GISCollective and Green Map GIS applications
Low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of HTTP requests/sec, async I/O, caching, fibers)
Broad adaptability across languages and full-stack layers, matching the role's learning expectations
concerns: Modern C++ experience is minimal and roughly a decade old; no Rust experience listed
No direct experience with routing engines, routing tiles, or navigation guidance systems
Recent years focused on TypeScript/Node.js product and web work, not systems-level engineering
